name: Ho Chi Minh City
tagline: History by day, food after dark
summary: Districts 1 and 3 hold a useful first-visit cluster of museums, colonial-era buildings and food stops. Cu Chi deserves a separate half-to-full day because road travel is substantial.
seasonNote: Dry-season months are easier for walking; rainy-season showers can be intense and heat persists year-round.
arrival: Tan Son Nhat is close geographically but congestion makes transfer time variable; use an official or app-booked ride.
gettingAround: Walk selected central blocks, then use booked cars; crossings need attention and pavements may be obstructed.
cashTip: Carry dong for small restaurants and markets; use cards in established hotels and larger shops.
foodTip: Try com tam, banh mi and banh xeo; ask about pork, fish sauce and herbs.
buyTip: Coffee, chocolate and lacquerware are practical gifts; use reputable shops for quality purchases.
baseArea: District 1 near Ben Thanh or District 3 for a calmer base.

connections.note: Check current schedules; transfer time extra.
